bullets.text: Microsoft Flight Simulator's New Mission - Players engage in aerial firefighting with RFS-inspired missions in Australia.
Azure Expands in Europe - Microsoft Azure scales cloud and AI infrastructure to meet rising demand across Europe.
New Windows Insider Builds - Microsoft releases new Windows 11 Insider Preview Builds for enhanced user experience.
Dirty Frag Vulnerability Disclosed - A new Linux vulnerability allows privilege escalation, posing risks to various distributions.
Free Microsoft Store Registration - Companies can now publish to the Microsoft Store with free registration and faster onboarding.
World Passkey Day Celebrated - Microsoft promotes passwordless authentication to enhance security and reduce phishing risks.
Microsoft Leads in AI Security - Recognized as a leader in KuppingerCole's 2026 AI Security Operations Center report.
AI Agent Framework Vulnerabilities - Microsoft identifies critical vulnerabilities in AI frameworks that could lead to RCE.
ClickFix Campaign Targets macOS - New phishing campaign uses fake utilities to deliver infostealers to macOS users.
